name: Spiritus Natalis: A String Quartet Concert with Adlib Strings
description: Adlib Strings play classical pieces and traditional Christmas melodies inside Igreja dos Clérigos, with festive projections by OCUBO. Friday 18 December at 21:00, tickets from €24.
longDescription:
Spiritus Natalis is a Christmas concert by the string quartet Adlib Strings inside Igreja dos Clérigos. The programme mixes classical pieces with traditional Christmas melodies, and festive video projections by OCUBO move across the Baroque interior while they play.

The church is small enough that the acoustics feel close, and Fever describes the concert as a Porto tradition that returns this year. It's recommended for ages 12 and up. Photos and video are allowed during the concert as long as you don't use flash.

The concert is on Friday 18 December at 21:00 at Igreja dos Clérigos, Rua de São Filipe de Nery. Tickets start at €24. Doors open 15 minutes before the start and there's no waiting area inside the church, so don't arrive too early.
